title: FluxJobs
description: An immersive, fully customizable job and economy system featuring dynamic NPC contracts, a progression skill tree, and engaging risk-reward bargaining
body:
Flux Jobs System

Bring your server's economy to life with an interactive, dynamic, and fully customizable job experience.

Tired of basic, chat-based job plugins that feel repetitive? Flux Jobs System transforms the way your players interact with the server economy. Instead of simple command usage, your players will engage with Job Masters (NPCs), choose their difficulty levels, and progress through a dynamic Skill Tree to maximize their efficiency.

Key Features

Dynamic NPC Contracts: Experience a more immersive economy. Players don't just "start a job"; they find and interact with Job Masters to accept active contracts.

6 Specialized Professions: Includes Farming, Woodcutting, Husbandry, Mining, Fishing, and Hunting, each with custom materials and rewards.

Difficulty Multipliers: Challenge your players! Choose between Easy, Medium, or Hard difficulty levels, with customizable multipliers for rewards and XP.

Advanced Skill Tree: Unlock special perks as you level up. Customize the progression directly from the configuration file.

Bargaining System: Take risks for higher rewards! A unique, RNG-based bargaining system allows players to potentially multiply their payouts by 1.5x—or lose half if they fail.

Modern GUI Interface: Sleek, high-quality menus designed with gradients and small-caps text for a premium server feel.

Fully Configurable: Everything from job payouts, material requirements, and NPC slots to skill tree nodes can be adjusted to fit your server's balance.

Progression & Customization

The Flux Jobs System is designed for server owners who care about balance. Whether you want a hardcore economy or a casual experience, you can fine-tune every aspect of the plugin via config.yml:

Skill Tree Customization: Easily set level requirements, bonus percentages, and GUI slots for each perk node.

Reward Balancing: Configure minimum/maximum money and XP rewards for every job to keep your economy stable.

Interactive UI: Your players can track their career progress, view their XP, and manage their current contracts through an intuitive GUI.

Installation

Download the latest FluxJobs.jar.

Place the file in your plugins folder.

Restart your server.

Customize the config.yml to match your server's economy and enjoy!

Commands

/jobs - Open the main menu.

/jobs help - View available commands.

/jobs reload - Reload plugin configurations.

Need help or have suggestions? Join our https://discord.gg/5eTw8StmDR to get support!
